channel.title: Tampa Bay News Monitor
channel.description: Press releases and breaking news, Tampa Bay

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] US suspends avocado inspections in Mexican state of Michoacan due to threat
item.description: The United States says it has suspended all government operations in the Mexican state of Michoacan because of a "threat to U.S. interests."

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Powerball jackpot grows to $856 million
item.description: There was no Powerball jackpot winner in Wednesday night's drawing, according to the lottery's website.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] CDC says 15 states now linked to cyclospora lettuce outbreak
item.description: Federal investigators are tracing a major cyclospora outbreak to contaminated iceberg lettuce served at restaurants in multiple states.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Seminole High School in the midst of $60 million renovation project
item.description: Seminole High School is in the midst of a $60 million renovation project which includes a new cafeteria, state-of-the-art classrooms, expanded courtyard and new front office.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] ‘Buying homes with other people's money’: Tampa Bay Gen Z homebuyer uses the market to her advantage
item.description: A Tampa Bay teacher bought her first home at 25 despite high prices and mortgage rates. Experts share tips for Gen Z buyers looking to break into the market.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] 'The Bad Guardian' film on guardianship abuse screened on Capitol Hill
item.description: Concerns about guardianship abuse took center stage at the Whistleblower Summit and Film Festival on Capitol Hill, where the Lifetime film "The Bad Guardian" was screened for lawmakers and advocates.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Senate committee votes to hold Dr. Fauci in contempt of Congress
item.description: A Republican-led Senate committee advanced a contempt measure against Dr. Anthony Fauci following testimony on COVID-19 origins.

item.title: [BREAKING] [FOX 13 Tampa Bay] Self-defense or murder? Stand your ground hearing begins in shooting death of DJ Shy Guy
item.description: Joel Moreno Cobo is accused of shooting and killing Dedrick Sykes, known in Tampa as "DJ Shy Guy," during a road-rage confrontation in Ybor City last November.
